Definition: to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tremble, quake, move about, be afraid, be startled, be terrified; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tremble, quake (of a mountain); 1a2) to tremble (of people); 1a3) to be anxiously careful; 1a4) to go or come trembling (with prep); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to tremble; 1b2) to drive in terror, rout (an army)
